enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Bend right knee. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe. Stretch left arm. Turn to back. Move head. Remain still. Sleep.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl from cabinet. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Scoop cereal. Bring spoon to mouth. Eat cereal. Repeat scooping and eating. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Put bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Stand in front of mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to therapy room. Turn on computer. Open patient files. Call patient. Greet patient. Assist patient to walk. Demonstrate exercise. Adjust patient's leg. Apply resistance. Record progress. Walk patient back. Clean equipment. Call next patient. Repeat exercises. Write notes. End shift.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing without air conditioning due to peak request
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Pour glass of water. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water.

Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Take snack. Walk back. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Bend knee. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Breathe. Stretch arm. Remain still. Sleep.
